question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Absorbed
solution:
The correct answer is "**Soaked.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **The word 'absorbed' means fully engrossed or deeply involved in something.(**किसी चीज़ में पूरी तरह तल्लीन या गहराई से शामिल होना**)**

 
 
• Example: She was so absorbed in her book that she didn't notice the time passing.
 
 
 
• **The word 'soaked' (भीगा हुआ) also means fully immersed or absorbed in something**.
 
 
• Example: He was soaked in rain when he came home.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "soaked" is synonym of the word "absorbed."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Option 1: Preoccupied (बेचैन) **means distracted or worried about something else.
 
• **Option 3: Restored (पुनर्स्थापित)** means brought back to its original state or condition.
 
• **Option 4: Replaced (प्रतिस्थापित) **means substituted or exchanged for something else.
